about: The Workbench icons of the OpenLieroX drawer: python3 /mnt/amigachrome/team2/tools/amicradle/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons. The art is OpenLieroX's own program icon (share/OpenLieroX.64.png, LGPL like the program). OpenLieroX-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, OpenLieroX.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's OpenLieroX.info. Data.info is the icon of every data subdrawer (the Makefile copies it to each name).
